summary: Bossa nova: 120–145 BPM felt in 2, rim-click clave and soft kick, nylon guitar, maj7 and dominant chords
body: Drums: soft, brushes or rim clicks in the bossa clave, kick on 1 and the and of 2, shaker 8ths.
Harmony: maj7, m7, 7(9) and diminished chords; Imaj7–VI7–ii7–V7.
Guitar: nylon, syncopated comping; bass on 1 and 3, root and fifth.
Soft and intimate: low levels, little effect.

Apply: pattern/gmd-latin-brazilian-bossa-beat-1 on the drums, then pattern/prog-bossa-nova-common-4 on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 120–145 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one
